facts.value: Goethe University and affiliated institutions offer a wide range of services related to 'My Career'. On the following pages, you will quickly and easily find numerous contacts and the relevant links: important job portals, schedules for workshops, key skills training sessions, or job fairs, as well as offers for individual advice from application document checks to general career orientation. Many experts with extensive knowledge and valuable tips are available to support you on your way to practical work experience. Go on a discovery journey!
